projects.name: fbchat-pyppeteer
projects.title: Fbchat Pyppeteer
projects.description: Facebook Chat automation library using Pyppeteer for browser-based messaging. Provides programmatic access to Facebook Messenger through headless browser control, enabling bot development and automated messaging workflows.
projects.unique_aspects: Facebook Chat automation library using Pyppeteer for browser-based messaging. Provides programmatic access to Facebook Messenger through headless browser control, enabling bot development and automated messaging workflows.

projects.name: mynotes
projects.title: Mynotes
projects.description: A comprehensive note-taking application built with Flutter, demonstrating full-stack mobile development capabilities with Firebase authentication integration. This cross-platform app showcases implementation of user authentication, CRUD operations for notes, and responsive UI design across iOS, Android, web, and desktop platforms. The project reflects understanding of modern mobile development architecture, state management, and cloud-based backend integration.

projects.name: Problem-Solving
projects.title: Problem Solving
projects.description: An extensive collection of problem-solving implementations primarily in C and C++, containing 276 C++ files and 111 C files covering various algorithmic challenges. This repository serves as a comprehensive archive of competitive programming practice, demonstrating proficiency in data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving techniques. The large number of solutions indicates consistent practice and dedication to improving programming skills through platforms like UVa, Codeforces, or similar online judges.
